title: Envelope
description: The call envelope attached to every outbound Dark Factory tool call. See docs/conventions/envelope.md and ADR-0005.

run_id.description: The run this call is part of.

stage_id.description: The pipeline stage currently executing. `conformance` is not a pipeline stage: it marks a call made outside any run, by df.servers.register's conformance check (docs/conventions/describe.md). Every outbound call carries an envelope with a deadline, including that one, so the value has to exist rather than the envelope being omitted. `intake` and `spec` are retained while the engine still runs them; ADR-0003's amendment removes them from runs in step 3c.

project_id.description: The project the run belongs to.

idempotency_key.description: Stable per logical attempt; lets a callee dedupe retried calls.

deadline.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which the caller treats the call as timed out.

callback_token.description: Signed token to use when POSTing async job completion back to /webhooks/jobs/{job_id}. Present only on calls the factory expects may go async.
